name: fao-agrovoc
label: FAO AgrInfo / AGROVOC
description: UN Food and Agriculture Organization data standards — food security, agricultural statistics

table_notes.fao_country: FAO country/territory reference list with proprietary FAO codes alongside ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 and alpha-3 codes and UN regional groupings.
table_notes.fao_item: FAO commodity and item catalogue used across all FAOSTAT datasets; each item has a unique FAO code, category, and default measurement unit.
table_notes.fao_production: Annual crop and livestock production statistics from FAOSTAT; one row per country/item/element/year combination with a data-quality flag.
table_notes.fao_trade: Bilateral agricultural trade flows from FAOSTAT; one row per reporter-country, partner-country, commodity, and year with quantity and USD value.
table_notes.agrovoc_concept: AGROVOC SKOS thesaurus concepts; stores the broader hierarchy as a self-referencing FK and related/alternate labels as JSONB arrays.

fao_country.name: fao_code
fao_country.description: FAO-assigned numeric country code (unique across FAOSTAT datasets)

fao_country.name: name
fao_country.description: Official English country or territory name as used by FAO

fao_country.name: region
fao_country.description: FAO macro-regional grouping (e.g. Africa, Asia, Europe)

fao_country.name: sub_region
fao_country.description: FAO sub-regional grouping within the macro-region (e.g. Eastern Africa)

fao_item.name: fao_code
fao_item.description: FAO item/commodity code used in all FAOSTAT downloads (e.g. 15 = Wheat)

fao_item.name: name
fao_item.description: Official English name of the commodity or item

fao_item.name: category
fao_item.description: Broad commodity category (e.g. Cereals, Vegetables, Livestock)

fao_item.name: commodity_group
fao_item.description: Finer commodity grouping within the category (e.g. Coarse Grains)

fao_item.name: unit
fao_item.description: Default measurement unit for this item (e.g. tonnes, head, 1000 USD)

fao_production.name: id
fao_production.description: Surrogate primary key (bigint for large FAOSTAT row volumes)

fao_production.name: country_id
fao_production.description: References fao_country — the country or territory that produced the commodity

fao_production.name: item_id
fao_production.description: References fao_item — the commodity being measured

fao_production.name: element
fao_production.description: FAOSTAT element label indicating what is measured (e.g. Production, Area harvested, Yield)

fao_production.name: year
fao_production.description: Reference year of the statistic (calendar year)

fao_production.name: value
fao_production.description: Reported numeric value in the unit specified by fao_item.unit

fao_production.name: unit
fao_production.description: Unit of measurement for this specific row (may override the item default)

fao_production.name: flag
fao_production.description: FAOSTAT data-quality flag (e.g. E=estimate, F=FAO figure, I=imputed, M=missing)

fao_trade.name: id
fao_trade.description: Surrogate primary key (bigint for bilateral trade row volumes)

fao_trade.name: reporter_id
fao_trade.description: References fao_country — the country reporting the trade flow

fao_trade.name: partner_id
fao_trade.description: References fao_country — the trading partner country

fao_trade.name: flow
fao_trade.description: Trade flow direction: Import or Export

fao_trade.name: year
fao_trade.description: Reference year of the trade statistic (calendar year)

fao_trade.name: value_usd
fao_trade.description: Trade value in thousands of US dollars (1000 USD) as reported by FAO

agrovoc_concept.name: uri
agrovoc_concept.description: Canonical AGROVOC SKOS URI (e.g. http://aims.fao.org/aos/agrovoc/c_330) — stable across versions

agrovoc_concept.name: prefLabel_en
agrovoc_concept.description: Preferred English label for this concept per SKOS skos:prefLabel

agrovoc_concept.name: broader_id
agrovoc_concept.description: Self-referencing FK to the broader (parent) concept per SKOS skos:broader hierarchy

agrovoc_concept.name: related
agrovoc_concept.description: JSONB array of URIs for associatively related concepts (skos:related); e.g. ["http://...c_123"]

agrovoc_concept.name: alt_labels
agrovoc_concept.description: JSONB map of language codes to alternate label arrays (skos:altLabel); e.g. {"en": ["maize"]}

short_description: UN Food and Agriculture Organization data standards — food security, agricultural statistics
long_description: FAO AGROVOC is the UN Food and Agriculture Organization's multilingual thesaurus covering agriculture, forestry, fisheries, food, and related topics with 40,000+ concepts in 40+ languages. The schema also includes FAO production and trade statistics tables for storing FAOSTAT data — commodity production by country and year, and bilateral trade flows.
when_to_use: Use for food security information systems, agricultural statistics portals, commodity trading platforms, or any application needing FAO-standard crop/livestock classification. AGROVOC is the reference vocabulary for FAO, Bioversity International, and CIGAR. FAOSTAT data is required for SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) monitoring reports and national food security assessments.
